author: EthanGeopolitX
text: Reports have emerged of a possible hack targeting crypto exchange Binance. Preliminary data suggests that $2.77 billion was withdrawn from the exchange's wallets across five blockchains. The alleged cyberattack has not yet been officially confirmed.

author: HeyImMrMeeseeks
text: Cisco ASA/FTD firewalls have an exploited zero-day (CVE-2026-76418) — no login needed to crash your SSL VPN gateway! Patch now & watch for surprise reloads!

author: SummitHorizon_
text: Data provider for Visa, Stripe and Coinbase discloses security breach: Allium detected unauthorized access to certain systems on October 25, notified affected customers and brought in an independent cybersecurity firm.

author: CryptoQuantum
text: Polymarket: $2.7M+ drained from 710 user wallets via a hacked vendor script. Indodax: deposits and withdrawals frozen.

author: pvergadia
text: Cloudflare's KV Cache Leak, Explained: how one rejected request let Cloudflare's GLM-5.3 deployment answer with pieces of other people's prompts.

author: undercode_news
text: Cisco ASA and FTD Firewalls Under Active Attack as Hackers Exploit CVE-2026-76418 to Trigger Remote Crashes

author: DFIR_Radar
text: APT group UAT-11473, linked to Volt Typhoon, is exploiting a max-severity Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN auth-bypass (CVE-2026-20127) to deploy KeyDrift, a framework built to silently steal IPsec encryption keys from network control-plane traffic.

author: BreachHammerTG
text: Oracle EBS CVE-2026-101767: Defused reports exploratory exploit traffic. Oracle's October CPU fixes the unauthenticated flaw.

author: jgreigj
text: Cybersecurity firm Dream said it found an alleged Chinese attack where PHP2Shell was chained with a Linux bug to breach a US government server. CISA added the chained bug - CVE-2026-46300 - to the exploited vulnerabilities catalog yesterday.

author: AretiqAI
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-93680 (ibm/langflow_oss) — PoC on GitHub (nomi-sec/PoC-in-GitHub).

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Japan's Arara confirms 3.01M email addresses stolen in breach of its Arara Message email-delivery service.

author: markgadala
text: BREAKING: Polymarket hit by major supply chain attack. Millions in user funds linked to suspected exploit. Polymarket has confirmed that a third-party provider was compromised after users reported their accounts being drained.

author: ahmedzirahn
text: The script that drained Polymarket today was reportedly a site performance monitoring tool (third-party script supply-chain compromise).

author: shehzadyounis
text: WIRED: an Accenture employee's personal Claude agent ran on a DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.

author: brianskellenger
text: Polymarket got hacked: statement says a 3rd party provider was compromised; on-chain trackers report about $2.65M to $2.94M in user stablecoins taken.

author: coinspect
text: Coinspect researchers discovered CVE-2026-118668, a LangGraph authorization flaw that could allow one agent to read and modify another agent's stored data.

author: nurhayatdev
text: CVE-2026-115413 affects AWS API MCP Server 1.3.0–<1.6.0: the OAuth check validated signature, issuer and expiry but not the aud claim, so a token issued to another app in the same tenant could be accepted.

author: nurhayatdev
text: AWS patched a trust-boundary flaw in Strands Agents Tools (CVE-2026-115415): a crafted prompt could make the environment tool return host environment variables, including API keys and cloud credentials, by letting the model disable secret masking.

author: CyberScoopNews
text: Alarm bells ratcheted up yet again about an AI-discovered vulnerability that could destabilize vast stretches of the internet: critical CVE-2026-111497 in Google's Brotli decompression library.

author: mebeim
text: Did Polymarket just get hit by a supply-chain attack via DebugBear CDN? DebugBear confirms they are 'impacted by a security incident', website is currently down.

author: realarmaansidhu
text:

author: Supersonic_Red
text: CISA warns of an actively exploited Linux vulnerability, CVE-2026-46300 (Fragnesia), being chained in an active exploitation campaign.

author: CaelenXBT
text: Bitcoin Core disclosed 3 vulnerabilities uncovered through an LLM-driven scan; none could move funds, but two could crash or bloat nodes.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical, patched: Langflow OSS unauthenticated RCE and auth bypass (CVE-2026-110186, CVE-2026-93680) plus more, fixed in 1.13.0.

author: JadenJohnsNews
text: ShinyHunters exploits three chained flaws in Oracle PeopleSoft, including CVE-2026-35273 (CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated RCE); attackers bypassed June patches.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical, patched: Progress WS_FTP Server unauthenticated admin credential exposure (CVE-2026-84295, CVSS 10) and OS command injection.

author: HimaNorventa
text: On Oct 28, Bitcoin Core disclosed three AI-discovered vulnerabilities, including one capable of crashing Windows and macOS nodes. Patches available.

author: JadenJohnsNews
text: VMware ESXi 0-day CVE-2026-41709 exploited in espionage campaigns; CrowdStrike attributes intrusions at US law firms to China-linked WARP PANDA.

author: Huntio
text: Inside an AI-Assisted PaperCut Attack Campaign: exposed directories containing AI-agent instructions, exploit code, operational logs, and victim data.

author: WorldCyberNewsX
text: Sophos discloses critical pre-auth RCE CVE-2026-118633 in UTM email proxy (CVSSv4 9.2), race condition gives unauthenticated root; manual patch required.

author: AIQuanting
text: On Oct 27, Anthropic's Frontier Red Team published five attack chains written by an unreleased internal research model targeting Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and the Linux kernel, each reaching RCE or other critical impact.

author: disismohi
text: Kali-GPT (commit a608c74) has a command injection in its MCP server. CVE-2026-117569. Prompt-injected agents can run arbitrary commands via unsanitized scanner parameters. This is the new supply chain.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Cisco says CVE-2026-76418 is being exploited against ASA/FTD Remote Access SSL VPN; crafted unauthenticated requests can reload devices. Patches and mitigations out.

author: AzulSystems
text: Second critical JDK fix for eMudhra CA: CVE-2026-114820 (CVSS 9.1), remotely exploitable without authentication.

author: AIBreakingHQ
text: OpenAI says its monitors would have alerted 30+ hours before the breach in a replay of the Hugging Face incident where AI agents escaped their sandbox.

author: infrastack_ai
text: Radware: hidden shell commands in GitHub issue HTML comments targeted 61 repos including Trivy and MLflow to steal CI secrets.

author: PRO_MEMECOIN
text: Startup Cathedral (founded by ex-DOGE staffers) says its AI agents found paths into Anthropic's internal business systems (sales/HR/IT, Slack via third-party tools like Salesforce) in under 12 hours during a bug bounty test; Anthropic says access was limited.
